name: My Trading Card Shop! [BETA]
desc:
🃏 Welcome to My Trading Card Shop! 🃏

Open Anime, Soccer/Football (whatever you want to call it), American Football, Basketball, Baseball, Hockey, Critimon, or Brainrot packs, pull rare cards and build the best card shop in town!

THANK YOU FOR 2 MILLION VISITS!! Use code "2million" for a gift!

⚠️ This game is still in development! Please let me know of any bugs you encouter via the Feedback Mailbox, thank you!

💰 RUN YOUR SHOP WITH YOUR FRIENDS: Stock the shelves, set your prices and ring up customers at the till. Show off your best pulls and sell them!

🏆 COLLECT AND TRADE: Collect over 8,000 different cards and figurines, fill your album, grade your best cards, trade with other players and climb the leaderboards.

🔨 BUILD YOUR WAY: Grow your store and decorate it to your ultimate shop!

🎁 Daily rewards, plus 10% extra cash on sales when you play with friends!

⚡ Use code BETA for free rewards!

👍 Like and favorite for updates!

llm.loop: open card packs -> pull rare cards -> stock shelves and serve customers -> earn cash -> expand and decorate shop, grade and trade cards
llm.objectives: build the best card shop and complete the album
llm.progression: shop expansion, staff, 8,000+ cards, grading, leaderboards
llm.instructions: open packs, set prices, ring up customers, grade and trade cards
unique: store-sim crossed with real-style trading card pulls across sports/anime/brainrot
llm.thumbnails: noob holding rare cards, mystery pack with 0.013% odds, storefront
llm.complexity_notes: shop sim with customers AI, thousands of card assets
